input.quote: 2.1 Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
input.rationale: Section 2.1 imposes a three-year, USD 2,000,000-per-year take-or-pay commitment on us expressly "without reduction or termination rights" — the playbook's walk-away position, since there is no reduction or exit and no termination-for-convenience right elsewhere. It also fails the fallback, which would confine the commitment to the current 12-month term, make it reducible on 30 days' notice, and settle shortfalls by true-up rather than penalty, and it contradicts Section 12.3, where Vendor acknowledges Customer "has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment." The redline takes the preferred position with a minimal in-sentence edit: no minimum quantity, and Services payable on a usage or ordered basis without take-or-pay obligation.

ops.oldText: commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
ops.newText: commits to purchase no minimum quantity of Services in each of the next three years on a usage or ordered basis, without take-or-pay obligation.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a multi-year take-or-pay minimum with no reduction or termination right, so the USD 2,000,000 minimum is removed and Services are payable on a usage or ordered basis only.
proposal.summary: No minimum commitment; Services payable on a usage or ordered basis only.

mappings.element: Fees only for usage or ordered Services.
